clauses.treatment_must_reach: mean probes to identification <= 6.320 (= 1.05 x GREEDY_REF 6.019); entropy bound for any non-oracle policy is 6.0, so this bar is reachable in principle by a legitimate policy
95th percentile of probes over the 640 episodes <= 8 (GREEDY_REF p95 = 6)

revisions.what: initial spec: S1 mean probes(X)/mean probes(GREEDY_REF) <= 0.95 (beat greedy information gain by 5%); S2 mean probes <= 9.0; S3 bits per probe log2(64)/mean >= 0.65
revisions.result: PC (truth oracle) S1=0.389 S2=2.34 S3=2.56; NULL_TWIN S1=2.19 S2=13.18 S3=0.455; all attainable and discriminating on the oracle, BUT GREEDY_REF mean = 6.019 probes against an entropy lower bound of 6.0 for any policy that does not know the truth, so the S1 bar (5.718) is reachable ONLY by the oracle. Not frozen by the added legitimate-policy feasibility check.
revisions.why_changed: this is the W4 defect in another form (a threshold the positive control reaches only because it is an oracle). Beating greedy in mean probes is information-theoretically impossible on this substrate; S1 reformulated as parity with greedy, S3 (redundant with S2: bits = 6/mean) replaced by a worst-case clause, the property a separating family is supposed to buy
